findings.desc: Operator creates product (should be PLANNER/MANAGER/ADMIN only)
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: POST /products on /products restricted to authorized roles only
findings.expected: Role OPERATOR should receive 403 Forbidden for POST /products

findings.desc: Operator modifies product cost (should be MANAGER/ADMIN only)
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: PUT cost modification on /products/mat-001 restricted to authorized roles only
findings.expected: Role OPERATOR should receive 403 Forbidden for PUT cost modification

findings.desc: Operator deletes work order (should be MANAGER/ADMIN only)
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: DELETE /work-orders on /work-orders/wo-002 restricted to authorized roles only
findings.expected: Role OPERATOR should receive 403 Forbidden for DELETE /work-orders

findings.desc: Operator from fac-002 reports on fac-001 work order (factory scope)
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: Operator factory must match work order factory
findings.expected: Operator from fac-002 rejected for fac-001 work order (403)
findings.evidence: POST /work-reports as fac-002 operator on fac-001 WO -> 201

findings.desc: Globex manager lists work centers (should only see globex)
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: /work-centers listing must be org-scoped (multi-tenant isolation)
findings.expected: Actor from 'globex' should only see globex records
findings.actual: Response contains 4 records from other orgs
findings.evidence: GET http://localhost:8020/work-centers as globex -> found orgs: {'acme', 'globex'}

findings.desc: Release a COMPLETED work order (should be rejected)
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: WorkOrder transition 'release' only from ['CREATED']
findings.expected: Cannot release from state COMPLETED (expect 409)

findings.desc: Close work order from IN_PRODUCTION (should require COMPLETED first)
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: WorkOrder transition 'close' only from ['COMPLETED']
findings.expected: Cannot close from state IN_PRODUCTION (expect 409)

findings.desc: Modify CONFIRMED production plan (should be immutable)
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: ProductionPlan transition 'update' only from ['CREATED']
findings.expected: Cannot update from state CONFIRMED (expect 409)

findings.desc: Modify sales order after linked plan confirmed
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: Cannot modify delivery_date if linked plan is CONFIRMED
findings.expected: Modification rejected (409) because linked plan pp-001 is CONFIRMED

findings.desc: Create receipt for non-COMPLETED work order
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: Work Order must be COMPLETED before receipt creation
findings.expected: Work Order must be COMPLETED before receipt creation
findings.evidence: POST http://localhost:8020/finished-goods-receipts -> 201: Receipt created for RELEASED WO (status 201)

findings.desc: Create work order with non-existent BOM/Routing
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: Product must have active BOM and Routing (precondition)
findings.expected: Product must have active BOM and Routing (precondition)
findings.evidence: POST http://localhost:8020/work-orders -> 201: WO created with invalid BOM/Routing (status 201)

findings.desc: Start work order without material reservations
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: All material reservations must be RESERVED before start
findings.expected: All material reservations must be RESERVED before start

findings.desc: Complete work order with pending operations
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: All operations must be COMPLETED before work order completion
findings.expected: All operations must be COMPLETED before work order completion
findings.evidence: POST http://localhost:8020/work-orders/wo-001/complete -> 200: WO completed with PENDING operations (status 200)

findings.desc: Create rework order for PASS inspection (should require REJECT)
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: Referenced inspection must have result=REJECT for rework creation
findings.expected: Referenced inspection must have result=REJECT for rework creation
findings.evidence: POST http://localhost:8020/rework-orders -> 201: Rework created for PASS inspection (status 201)

findings.desc: Create receipt without quality inspection PASS
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: At least one Quality Inspection with PASS result required
findings.expected: At least one Quality Inspection with PASS result required
findings.evidence: POST http://localhost:8020/finished-goods-receipts -> 201: Receipt created without quality PASS (status 201)

findings.desc: Create WO with quantity exceeding production plan
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: Work order quantity should be validated against production plan
findings.expected: Work order quantity should be validated against production plan
findings.evidence: POST http://localhost:8020/work-orders -> 201: WO qty 999 exceeds plan qty 100 (status 201)

findings.desc: Material issue exceeds reserved quantity
findings.constraint: API_SPEC/BUSINESS_RULES: Issue quantity must not exceed reserved_quantity - issued_quantity
findings.expected: Issue quantity must not exceed reserved_quantity - issued_quantity

findings.desc: Work report quantity exceeds planned quantity
findings.constraint: API_SPEC/BUSINESS_RULES: Reported quantity must not exceed remaining planned quantity
findings.expected: Reported quantity must not exceed remaining planned quantity

findings.desc: Duplicate sales order with same order_ref (should be 409)
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: /sales-orders idempotency on order_ref (duplicate returns 409)
findings.expected: Duplicate order_ref should return 409 Conflict

findings.desc: Duplicate receipt for same work order (should be 409)
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: /finished-goods-receipts idempotency on work_order_id (duplicate returns 409)
findings.expected: Duplicate work_order_id should return 409 Conflict

findings.desc: Cancel WO does not release material reservations
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: Cancel must release all material reservations
findings.expected: All reservations status -> RELEASED after cancel

findings.desc: Delete BOM leaves orphan lines
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: DELETE /boms deletes BOM and all its lines
findings.expected: BOM lines deleted with parent BOM

findings.desc: Create WO with planned_start after planned_end
findings.constraint: API_SPEC/BUSINESS_RULES: planned_start must be earlier than planned_end
findings.expected: planned_start must be earlier than planned_end
findings.evidence: POST http://localhost:8020/work-orders -> 201: WO created with start>end (status 201)

findings.desc: Modify sales order after linked plan confirmed
findings.constraint: API_SPEC/BUSINESS_RULES: Sales order immutable after linked production plan confirmed
findings.expected: Sales order immutable after linked production plan confirmed
findings.evidence: PUT http://localhost:8020/sales-orders/so-001 -> 200: SO modified after plan confirm (status 200)

findings.desc: Update WO with stale version (should be 409)
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: /work-orders requires version check (optimistic locking, 409 on mismatch)
findings.expected: Update with stale version 0 should return 409

findings.desc: Return material issue with stale version
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: /material-issues requires version check (optimistic locking, 409 on mismatch)
findings.expected: Update with stale version 1 should return 409

findings.desc: Bulk release with one invalid WO (should all fail)
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: /work-orders/bulk-release batch semantics: all-or-nothing
findings.expected: Batch should be atomic (all-or-nothing)

findings.desc: Bulk issue with invalid reservation (should be atomic)
findings.constraint: API_SPEC: /material-issues/bulk-issue batch semantics: atomic (if any fails, none created)
findings.expected: Batch should be atomic (atomic (if any fails, none created))
